Review complete. **Verdict: approve** (tier1).

I independently verified the fix rather than trusting the commit message — diffing `registries:` id sets between the pre-regression baseline (c9cea46b) and current HEAD confirms all 50 original repo-only entries survived with zero removals, plus 8 legitimate new entries added. The large diff stat (2112+/2972-) turned out to be mostly a CRLF→LF line-ending normalization artifact, not extensive content rewriting. YAML parses cleanly; nothing touches `.github/workflows/**`; correctly classified tier1.

One real but non-blocking gap I found: the 7 new `registries:` entries were never mirrored into `quick_reference:`, which this same file's own header instructions require after any registries edit. Flagged as a follow-up issue in `review-verdict.json`, written to the workspace root as requested.
